questions.question: Analyse the importance of conflict resolution strategies for relationship satisfaction.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse the importance of conflict resolution strategies for relationship
  • satisfaction.
  • Answer : Conflict is a natural and unavoidable part of intimate relationships because
  • partners differ in their needs, expectations, and personalities. However, the way conflicts
  • are managed determines whether a relationship becomes stronger or weaker. Effective
  • conflict resolution strategies play an important role in maintaining relationship
  • satisfaction, emotional stability, and long-term commitment. According to the Caryl E.
  • Rusbult Accommodation Model, individuals who are highly committed to a relationship
  • tend to respond to conflict in constructive ways rather than destructive ways. Strategies
  • such as acceptance, trust, forgiveness, and responsiveness help partners maintain
  • harmony and satisfaction. Acceptance is an important strategy in conflict resolution. It
  • involves recognizing that every partner has strengths and weaknesses and that
  • disagreements are a normal part of relationships. When partners accept each other’s
  • imperfections instead of reacting with anger or criticism, conflicts become less intense.
  • Acceptance promotes patience and emotional maturity, which contributes to long-term
  • relationship satisfaction. Trust is another key factor that helps partners handle
  • disagreements effectively. Trust refers to the belief that one’s partner is reliable, caring
  • and committed to the relationship. When trust exists, partners are less likely to
  • misinterpret each other’s behavior negatively during conflicts. This reduces suspicion and
  • encourages open communication, thereby strengthening the relationship bond.
  • Forgiveness also plays a significant role in maintaining relationship satisfaction. It
  • involves letting go of anger and resentment when a partner makes a mistake or causes
  • hurt. Forgiveness prevents negative emotions from accumulating and helps partners
  • rebuild emotional closeness. By choosing forgiveness over revenge or hostility, couples
  • protect the stability of their relationship. Finally, responsiveness refers to being
  • emotionally supportive and attentive to a partner’s feelings during conflicts. When
  • partners listen carefully, show empathy, and validate each other’s emotions, conflicts
  • become opportunities for understanding rather than sources of hostility. Feeling heard and
  • valued strengthens emotional intimacy and increases satisfaction within the relationship.
questions.final_answer: valued strengthens emotional intimacy and increases satisfaction within the relationship

questions.question: What is PoSH act?
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: The PoSH Act refers to the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace
  • (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, a comprehensive legislation enacted in
  • India to ensure protection of women against sexual harassment at workplaces. The Act
  • was introduced following the landmark judgment in Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan, where
  • the Supreme Court recognized sexual harassment as a violation of fundamental rights
  • under Articles 14 (Right to Equality), 15 (Prohibition of discrimination), and 21 (Right to
  • Life and Dignity) of the Indian Constitution. Before this Act, there was no specific
  • statutory mechanism addressing workplace sexual harassment, and the Vishaka
  • Guidelines served as interim safeguards until formal legislation was enacted in 2013. The
  • PoSH Act defines sexual harassment broadly to include unwelcome physical contact and
  • advances, demand or request for sexual favours, making sexually coloured remarks
  • showing pornography, and any other unwelcome verbal, non-verbal, or physical conduct
  • of a sexual nature. The Act is based on three core principles: prevention, prohibition, and
  • redressal. It mandates that every organization with 10 or more employees must constitute
  • an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to address complaints. For establishments with
  • fewer than 10 employees or when the complaint is against the employer, a Local
  • Complaints Committee (LCC) is formed at the district level. The Act also places
  • responsibility on employers to conduct awareness programs, formulate anti-sexual
  • harassment policies, maintain confidentiality during inquiries, and submit annual
  • compliance reports. Thus, the PoSH Act is not merely punitive but preventive and
  • reformative, aiming to ensure safe, secure, and dignified workplaces for women.
questions.final_answer: reformative, aiming to ensure safe, secure, and dignified workplaces for women

questions.solution_html:
• Analyse violations of Human Rights in India.
  • Answer: Human rights in India remain a subject of intense debate, characterized by a
  • tension between robust constitutional protections and increasing reports of state-led
  • restrictions. While the Indian Constitution guarantees fundamental rights like equality and
  • freedom of speech, international monitoring bodies and domestic activists have raised
  • alarms over what they describe as a "deteriorating" human rights record. 1. Civil Liberties

  • Custodial and Security Force Abuses 4. Regional Focus: Jammu, Kashmir, and Manipur
